PreToolUse.description: Block git hook-bypass flags to protect pre-commit, commit-msg, and pre-push hooks from being skipped
Block modifications to linter/formatter config files — fix code, not config

Fact-forcing gate: deny a destructive bash command once until targets+rollback+instruction are stated (retry then allowed). Optional first-touch edit gate via FACT_FORCE_EDITS=1. Disable: FACT_FORCE_GUARD=off.
On `git commit`, scan staged content: block (exit 2) on secrets/debugger; warn on console.log and non-conventional subject. No external linters. Disable: PRECOMMIT_QUALITY=off.
Suggest /compact after every N (default 50) Edit/Write tool calls. Note: counter-based, not task-boundary-aware.
Log agent and skill invocations so the user sees what is being spawned in real time

Notice stuck tool loops (same tool+input >=3x in a window) and scope creep (>20 distinct files edited). stderr-only, never blocks. Tunables: LOOP_THRESHOLD, LOOP_WINDOW, SCOPE_THRESHOLD; disable via LOOP_SCOPE_GUARD=off.

Stop.description: Scan the final assistant message for unverified/hedge language (verify-before-claim.md) and surface a reminder to verify-or-tag. Catches hedged inference only, NOT confidently-stated wrong facts. Modes via VERIFY_HOOK_MODE: context (default, model-facing) | warn (user-facing) | block | off.
